model_type: Marginal Cox (clustered wounds within patient), conditional on PH; fallback is an AFT model with shared frailty
stratification: None
covariates: Treatment, TW depth (wound level), %TBSA (wound level), number of TWs (1, 2, ≥3); a time x treatment interaction for the PH check
ci_method: Not stated
ph_assessment: Time-since-randomization x treatment interaction (p<0.05 means non-PH)
nonph_handling: Log-logistic AFT model with a normal random subject effect (PROC NLMIXED). PH was rejected (p<0.0001) and the AFT model was used
